classification.difficultyReason: Identify the given sides relative to the marked angle in each supplied right triangle, select tangent or cosine and apply its inverse. Rotations and repeated parts add no linked reasoning.

content.prompt: Find the value of each pronumeral, correct to the nearest degree.
